title: Penniston's career stalled after Rendlesham

tellings.quote: um uh peniston you know not not making it to as high of a rank as he probably could have because he you know was a witness for the Rend

plain: A US Air Force airman named Jim Penniston, a witness to the 1980 UFO sighting in Rendlesham Forest in England, is said to have never reached the rank he probably could have because he was a witness. Michels raises this himself in a talk with the UFO investigator James Fox, without giving a source. If true, it would mean speaking up about a sighting can quietly cost a military career.
